blocks.heading: Two ways to develop with us

items.title: JV Co-development
items.description: We co-develop projects from initial screening to ready-to-build, leading the development process while our partner provides capital and participates at agreed decision points.

items.title: RtB Acquisition
items.description: We acquire Ready-to-Build projects, fully permitted and grid-connected.

items.title: Data-driven development
items.subtitle: The same engine we use for our own portfolio
items.description: Proprietary screening and AI-driven pipelines identify and develop the strongest opportunities — the same process behind every project we run ourselves.

items.title: Local market expertise
items.subtitle: Our DSO/DNO relationships and Polish market knowledge
items.description: Established relationships and on-the-ground knowledge move projects efficiently towards ready-to-build, with a faster, cleaner path than sourcing cold.

blocks.heading:
One process. Shared
at the right moments

items.title: Develop
items.description: We lead the development process. Our team screens, secures and de-risks each project end to end.

items.title: Decide together
items.description: At each key stage, both sides review the project and decide whether to continue, move towards ready-to-build, or pursue another path.

items.title: Transfer
items.description: Once the agreed stage is reached, the partner takes over the de-risked asset — or continues developing it with us.
